phase: Restore the paid-member membership surface. Root cause: pages/profile/profile.wxml gated the membership entry on wx:if="{{!isVip}}" so an ACTIVE member (membershipLevel='monthly') saw NO membership entry; the paid 会员中心 was registered but unreachable. Fix: an always-visible member entry driven by the SERVER authority (getMembership) with FREE / ACTIVE_MONTHLY / ACTIVE_ANNUAL / EXPIRED / UNKNOWN states; unknown/failure never rendered as free; active member is never forced to repurchase; membership page shows a detail state for paid members. No payment function change, no membership DB mutation, no manual grant.
scope: pages/profile/profile.{js,wxml,wxss} (always-visible member entry + goMembership routing by server state) + pages/membership/membership.{js,wxml,wxss} (paid-member detail state; no forced repurchase) + pages/membership-center/membership-center.{wxml,wxss} (member type badge) + tests/rc8.13/member-entry.test.js (new, A-L) + tests/rc8.13/run.js + .changes/current-change.json. No cloudfunctions, no payment channel, no entitlement/membership record changes.
